title: HAIS Agent
tagline: ReleaseKey is a product allowing sensistive data sharing across human beings and AI
description:
The project consist of empowering patient to share sensitive information to their doctors (application to other professions). Initially doctors/experts register themselves to our ENS: releasekey.eth and publish their name and public keys.
Then our app proposes the patient (Alice) to select one of them. After selection, we take voice record of the patient to assess their status (we could add more modalities, but settled on that one for now). Then the data is sent to an AI (Open AI here but could be local) for further analysis. The data is then coming back. Here Alice can properly assess the data and decide whether the information from AI is correct. We check with World that the patient is genuine. We run through a smart contract that checks whether the data was approved, and it allows for revokation.
The report is encrypted and stored locally in our app, but the approval is on the blockchain.
Then a doctor (Bob) can can retrieve the data en decrypt it via our app, providing that the data was not revoked.
how_its_made:
Claude: Used it primarily for coding and generating the UI and backend. It benefitted the project massively since we used it as our main source of development.
CLI Forgery tool: we used it for ENS creation and quick address creation. Turned out some actions were easier done via UI.
We used ENS for onboarding doctores keys. Integration could have been smoother but good experience overall.
We used World to assess patient human nature.
auto_summary: A web app and smart contract for consent-gated sharing of encrypted sensitive records, with ENS-based key lookup and World verification before release.
